CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bfr_staff_can_manage_student_scope(p_student_id uuid, p_subject text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select (
    (
      public.bfr_is_schedule_manager()
      and public.current_role()::text <> 'pedagogical'
    )
    or (
      public.current_role()::text = 'pedagogical'
      and public.bfr_pedagogical_can_manage_student(p_student_id, p_subject)
    )
    or (
      public.is_aee()
      and public.bfr_teacher_can_manage_student(p_student_id, p_subject)
    )
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public."current_role"()
 RETURNS account_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select role from public.profiles where id = auth.uid() $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_developer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select coalesce(public.current_role() = 'developer', false) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                  select coalesce(public.current_role() in ('pedagogical','aee','developer'), false)
                  $function$
